front.west_and_north_aslito: strongly contested; U.S. physical advantage remains but Japanese night rollback erased part of prior-day gain
front.bridgehead: secure; no Japanese threat to throw U.S. force into the sea

saipan.tinian_role: second logistics/aviation/reception node; receives western reinforcement, retains its own net increment, then relays bounded packets to Saipan

us_ground_casualties_cumulative.note: Working cumulative ground casualty class through 26 Jun 06:00; includes repeated Aslito fighting and 25 Jun bombardment/counterattack. Not a canonical casualty roll.

us_formation_damage.2d_marine_division: AMBER; rifle-company/NCO/officer and specialist gaps materially reduce cohesive offensive output below paper strength
us_formation_damage.4th_marine_division: AMBER-RED; longest continuous Aslito burden; multiple battalions need relief/reconstitution
us_formation_damage.27th_infantry_division: AMBER; no longer an operational reserve, now a current fighting formation
us_formation_damage.fresh_24h_reserve: roughly 2-4 battalion-equivalents across the three divisions
us_formation_damage.rifle_company_effect: many companies can show 70-80% paper strength while only producing about 55-70% cohesive offensive output; hardest-hit companies can be lower

us_specialist_and_equipment_damage.artillery_system_useful_output_general: about 75-85% class of an undamaged system, with worse local Aslito boxes

battleships.25_26jun_outcome: all eight forward battleships remain afloat and mobile; Hiei torpedo damage limits speed to roughly 25-27 kt; one Kongo-class heavy-hit candidate and additional topside damage do not mission-kill the main force

modern_destroyers.interpretation: Not a national exhaustion. The binding shortage is modern fleet-DD mission slots in the Marianas decisive system. Repeated DD-as-transport use is no longer preferred.
modern_destroyers.preferred_policy: Return modern DDs to screen/torpedo/contact roles; shift lift to cruisers, tenders, minelayers, landing ships and Tinian relay. Eight-BB forward penetration is feasible; all-12-BB close penetration remains too DD-hungry.

non_dd_transport_working_close.Aoba: GREEN/MR; Saipan-direct principal cruiser transport candidate
non_dd_transport_working_close.Kinu: AMBER-GREEN/limited MR after repair clock; Saipan-direct secondary cruiser transport
non_dd_transport_working_close.Nisshin: AMBER/transport MR after local repair; heavy cargo and specialist transport; not full aviation plus max cargo
non_dd_transport_working_close.Chitose: AMBER/transport MR; selected optional heavy-lift slot
non_dd_transport_working_close.Tsugaru: GREEN; Tinian/rear feeder, not close Saipan penetration
non_dd_transport_working_close.Itsukushima: GREEN; Tinian/rear feeder, not close Saipan penetration
non_dd_transport_working_close.T127_equivalent: low-speed rear feeder; not a fast direct-penetration asset
non_dd_transport_working_close.No4_high_speed_transport: limited transport MR / short work-up; carries Daihatsu and useful cargo; no surface-combat credit

25_26jun_decisive_relief.tinian_feeder: Tsugaru first; Itsukushima/T.127-class slower elements follow on later nights

priority: near-range attacks on U.S. CVE/NGFS/light screen when useful
25jun_doctrine.anti_tf58_release_gate: fresh contact <=45 min, range about 350-380 nm or less, good carrier-box identification, daylight recovery margin, U.S. deck cycle exposed, and CAP remains adequate

25jun_japanese_tf58_strike.center_effect: one fleet CV torpedo+bomb heavy aviation mission-kill/FORAGER immediate out; one CVL bomb and temporary deck stop; 15-25 deck/hangar aircraft irreversible

25jun_us_second_antisurface_wave.center_ship_effect: Nagato/Mutsu-class one bomb topside/AA/comms damage, fast-BB near miss, one DD medium damage; no BB torpedo mission kill

aviation.25jun_us_third_wave: No centered 80-100-aircraft third mass wave. Search/armed-recon/local opportunity effort only unless geometry changes.
aviation.post_25jun_japanese_air_loss: fighter losses are heavy and strike-leader quality remains a critical bottleneck; carrier hulls remain intact

tf58.state: still materially superior in absolute aviation, but divided across damaged-carrier escort, Saipan, CAP, search, ASW, carrier recovery and anti-surface tasks
tf58.25jun_additional_damage: one fleet CV heavy aviation mission-kill/FORAGER out; one CVL temporary closure
tf58.repeat_three_wave_capacity: materially worse than earlier working branch; next 48h regeneration of decks, crews, DDs and fuel becomes the key limiter

lee.state: still coherent stopper; 25/26 Jun night bounded gun exchange does not destroy either battle line
lee.25_26jun_effect: one U.S. fast BB takes a heavy 41/46cm hit class topside/secondary/fire-control damage while retaining speed; Japanese heavy ships also take bounded damage

26jun_decision.initial_reinforcement_choice: divert one 77th Infantry Division RCT-class package to Saipan before breaking the Guam amphibious assault core

movement_clock_center.29_30jun: RCT-scale coherent ground function if interdiction does not delay

other: LVT repair parts and bounded replacement vehicles

us_reconstitution.formation_conversion_rule: Arrival ashore is not HP restoration. Troops/equipment must unload, assemble, pair with crews/weapons/vehicles, establish C2, move inland, relieve existing units, and allow 36-72h class reconstitution of the relieved formations.
us_reconstitution.escalation_gate: If Aslito remains insecure around 29-30 Jun, Japanese reinforcement continues, Japanese fleet remains credible, and the first diverted RCT does not restore rotation, divert a second 77th RCT or part of the 1st Provisional Marine Brigade. That would effectively dissolve the original Guam schedule.

forager_project_state.reason: The U.S. must alter objective sequence, divert a Guam-bound RCT-class formation, and bring replacement personnel/equipment/amphibious support into Saipan before Tinian/Guam can resume. This is campaign redesign, not U.S. defeat.

rear_regeneration.home_bonins_marianas: continues as bounded small packets; all realized arrivals already included in current local-air states; no double counting
rear_regeneration.philippines_palau_carrier: continues repair/replacement/qualified-crew acceptance; not an instant second carrier air force
rear_regeneration.i400_i401: survived Eniwetok special strike and moved through replenishment/inspection; no automatic repeat six-aircraft strike; later use requires aircraft/catapult/hangar recertification and a valuable target

next_gates: Reconstruct U.S. unit-by-unit reconstitution: battalion/company leadership, specialists, artillery/FDC, armor, LVT/boat crews and shore-party throughput.
Trace the actual shipping/escort/landing movement of the diverted 77th RCT and replacement package rather than teleporting it to Saipan.
Decide Japanese 26-30 Jun posture while the U.S. reinforcement is in transit: fleet withdrawal/regeneration versus another bounded intervention.
Keep Tinian as a replenished relay node, not a free donor pool; track its own personnel/cargo/boat balance.
Audit modern-DD repair return and national reallocations before another all-battleship or large relief operation.
Do not promote post-14:15 events before the mandatory TF58 whole-system ASW meta-audit.
